h:
这使用的是最新型号欧尼金几天前发布：https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/OmniGen

确保自上一个版本以来更新您的节点，因为节点已经通过我的提交进行了彻底检修。

您现在可以更改模型、使用 FP8 模型等等！

如何安装：

的模型文件不再自动下载，因为您现在可以使用任何兼容的型号，包括 FP8 型号。

  1. 在 /ComfyUI/models/Omnigen 中的模型目录中创建一个 OmniGen 文件夹（该文件夹已从旧文件夹位置移动）

  2. 如果您之前已经下载过并且想要使用 BF16，将模型文件夹从\ComfyUI\models\AIFSH\Shitao\OmniGen-v1到\ComfyUI\models\OmniGen\OmniGen-v1

  3. 如果您还没有模型文件并想使用 BF16，在\ComfyUI\models\OmniGen从以下位置下载所有文件https://huggingface.co/Shitao/OmniGen-v1进入其自己的文件夹。

    您还可以使用 GIT 下载模型。

    首先做git LFS然后做克隆https://huggingface.co/Shitao/OmniGen-v1.

  4. 或者选择下载 FP8 版本使用与上面相同的方法，但对于该存储库：https://huggingface.co/silveroxides/OmniGen-V1-fp8_e4m3fn
    首先做git LFS然后做克隆https://huggingface.co/silveroxides/OmniGen-V1-fp8_e4m3fn .

    这可能需要一段时间，并且可能看起来好像暂时什么也没做。

  5. 使用 Comfy Manager 导入工作流程并安装缺失的节点！


观看此视频，了解一切可能（同时忽略安装说明）:


它使用大量节点来尽可能实现自动化。不过，所有这些都可以通过 Comfy Manager 获得。

享受吧！

o.en:
This uses the newest modelOmnigenreleased just a few days ago:https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/OmniGen

Be sure to update your nodes since the last version, since the nodes have been completely overhauled through my commits.

You can now change the model, use FP8 models, and more!

How to Install:

Themodel files are no longer automatically downloaded, since you can use any model you want now that is compatible, including FP8 models.

  1. Create an OmniGen folder the models directory in /ComfyUI/models/Omnigen (this has moved from the older folder location)

  2. If you've already downloaded it before and want to use BF16, move the model folder from\ComfyUI\models\AIFSH\Shitao\OmniGen-v1to\ComfyUI\models\OmniGen\OmniGen-v1

  3. If you don't have the model files yet and want to use BF16, within the\ComfyUI\models\OmniGendownload all of the files fromhttps://huggingface.co/Shitao/OmniGen-v1into its own folder.

    You can also download the models with GIT.

    First dogit LFSand afterwards dogit clonehttps://huggingface.co/Shitao/OmniGen-v1.

  4. Or optionally download the FP8 versionusing the same method as above, but instead for that repo:https://huggingface.co/silveroxides/OmniGen-V1-fp8_e4m3fn
    First dogit LFSand afterwards dogit clonehttps://huggingface.co/silveroxides/OmniGen-V1-fp8_e4m3fn .

    This can take awhile, and may appear as if it is doing nothing for a bit.

  5. Import workflow and install missing nodes with Comfy Manager!


Check out this video to see everything that is possible(while ignoring the installation instructions):


It uses a lot of nodes to automate as much as possible. All of them are available via Comfy Manager however.

Enjoy!
